newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lira meeting began with bilateral talks.
newsitem.headline: Lira meeting began with bilateral talks.

text.p: European Union finance ministers and central bank governors began their meeting on Sunday with bilateral talks, an EU source said.
The source said the main session had now begun, but that first there were various meetings between delegations. Italy had had talks with the chairman of the meeting.
"Depending on the results of those discussions we shall see," the source said.
Not much appeared to have been achieved during Saturday's meeting of finance ministry and central bank governors, the source said.
He said there was some concern that the decision on Sunday would be a signal for the future as regards the interpretation of the Maastricht criteria. He would not elaborate.

Earlier, Luxembourg Prime and Finance Minister Jean-Claude Juncker said Sunday's debate was not just about what rate the lira would enter the Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) but about putting Italy on track to meet one of the Maastricht criteria for the future single currency. - Brussels newsroom: +32 2 287-6830
